newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land Australian unit issues 36 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land Australian unit issues 36 mln shares.

text.p: DBS Land Ltd said on Monday, Australand Holdings Pty Ltd, in which it has a 60 percent stake, had issued 36.4 million converting preference shares (CPS) for A$40 million.
It said in a statement the purpose of the issue was to fund acquisitions of new projects.
Each CPS is issued at A$1.10 each to its shareholders, in proportion to their shareholdings.
DBS Land said its wholly-owned subsidiaries, Austrop Holdings Ltd and Austvale Holdings Ltd, would take up 18.2 million and 3.6 million shares respectively.
The CPS are convertible at one CPS to one ordinary share.
